notes.semetey-2-2013:p0027:b003:l029: Даңгыттарга жарайын is interpreted as making Semetey fit for, or presenting him to, the Danggits; the exact hostile idiom is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0027:b003:l034: Туулбай туна чөгөйүн is a self-curse, literally wishing to sink away as though unborn; the exact formula is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0027:b005:l006: Көөдөк is an insulting or critical epithet for rash Semetey; its exact bodily or moral nuance is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0027:b005:l015: Дөмөрчө names a mound, hummock, or projecting place by the circling water; its precise terrain sense is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0027:b005:l018: Энесинче заңгырап says Semetey cried out in the manner of his mother; the emotional comparison is retained.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0027:b005:l027: Кенедей күндө literally means when he was tick-sized, extending the louse/thumb-sized childhood formula.
